_comment: 로컬 영상 생성(tools/local-video.py --prompt-file)용 공격 프롬프트. 최종 프롬프트 = template의 {who}/{action}을 캐릭터별 값으로 채움. 기사(남)는 knight_01 확정본 기준.
template: Retro 16-bit pixel art sprite animation of the same {who} performing ONE single attack toward the right. {action} Then {pron} recovers and returns to the exact starting pose. Only one attack, no spinning, no second hit, no jumping. Strong anticipation and follow-through, but simple and readable. ABSOLUTELY NO visual effects of any kind: no slash trails, no motion lines, no speed lines, no glow, no aura, no sparks, no flash, no impact burst, no particles, no dust, no smoke, no blood, no magic circles, no energy, no swirls, no shapes or patterns in the background, nothing green. Only the character itself moves; the background stays a perfectly flat uniform pure green the whole time. Same pixel art style, colors and proportions as the first frame, crisp pixel edges. Locked static camera, no zoom, flat solid pure green background, no shadow, no ground.

warrior_01.who: warrior with a huge two-handed greatsword resting on his shoulder
warrior_01.action: Wind-up: he leans back and lifts the greatsword high over his head with both hands, his back partly turning to the camera. Strike: he steps forward and brings the greatsword down in one heavy two-handed overhead chop in front of him toward the right.

warrior_02.who: female warrior with a huge two-handed greatsword resting on her shoulder
warrior_02.action: Wind-up: she leans back and lifts the greatsword high over her head with both hands, her back partly turning to the camera. Strike: she steps forward and brings the greatsword down in one heavy two-handed overhead chop in front of her toward the right.

knight_01.action: Wind-up: he twists his upper body far back, turning so his back and shoulder partly face the camera, and raises the sword high behind his head. Strike: he steps forward and swings the sword down in one big powerful diagonal slash in front of him toward the right, with his full body weight.

knight_02.who: female armored knight with a large shield and a sword
knight_02.action: Wind-up: she raises the shield in front and pulls the sword back high behind her. Strike: she steps forward and swings the sword in one strong diagonal slash past the shield toward the right.

lancer_01.who: spearman holding a long spear upright
lancer_01.action: Wind-up: he lowers the spear to horizontal pointing right and pulls it back with both hands, crouching. Strike: he lunges forward and drives the spear in one long straight thrust toward the right.

lancer_02.who: female spear fighter holding a long spear upright
lancer_02.action: Wind-up: she lowers the spear to horizontal pointing right and pulls it back with both hands, crouching. Strike: she lunges forward and drives the spear in one long straight thrust toward the right.

assassin_01.action: Wind-up: he crouches low and draws the dagger back. Strike: he dashes a short step forward and makes one quick sharp slash with the dagger toward the right.

assassin_02.who: female ninja with a small blade
assassin_02.action: Wind-up: she crouches low and draws the blade back. Strike: she dashes a short step forward and makes one quick sharp slash toward the right.

archer_01.action: Wind-up: he raises the bow pointing right and pulls the bowstring back to his cheek, aiming. Strike: he releases the string, the bow snaps forward with a small recoil, the arrow flies off to the right out of view.

archer_02.who: female elf archer with a bow
archer_02.action: Wind-up: she raises the bow pointing right and pulls the bowstring back to her cheek, aiming. Strike: she releases the string, the bow snaps forward with a small recoil, the arrow flies off to the right out of view.

mage_01.who: old wizard with a wooden staff
mage_01.action: Wind-up: he raises the staff high with both hands as if gathering power. Strike: he thrusts the head of the staff forward toward the right in one strong casting motion.

mage_02.who: female mage holding a glowing orb in her hand
mage_02.action: Wind-up: she pulls the orb back close to her body. Strike: she pushes her hand with the orb forward toward the right in one strong casting motion, palm open.

priest_01.who: old priest with a jeweled staff
priest_01.action: Wind-up: he lifts the staff high above his head. Strike: he brings the staff down and points its head forward toward the right in one strong holy smite motion.

priest_02.who: female priest with a golden staff
priest_02.action: Wind-up: she lifts the staff high above her head. Strike: she brings the staff down and points its head forward toward the right in one strong holy smite motion.

shaman_01.who: tribal shaman holding a crystal orb
shaman_01.action: Wind-up: he lifts the orb up near his face. Strike: he thrusts the orb forward toward the right with an outstretched arm in one strong casting motion.

shaman_02.who: shrine maiden holding a paper talisman
shaman_02.action: Wind-up: she raises the paper talisman up between two fingers. Strike: she flicks her arm forward and throws the talisman toward the right in one quick motion.

summoner_01.who: young summoner with glasses holding an open book
summoner_01.action: Wind-up: he lifts the open book up and raises his free hand. Strike: he thrusts his free hand forward toward the right in one strong summoning gesture while holding the book.

summoner_02.who: female summoner with a crystal staff
summoner_02.action: Wind-up: she raises the staff high. Strike: she swings the staff forward and points its crystal toward the right in one strong summoning motion.

brawler_01.action: Wind-up: he takes a stance and pulls his right fist back to his hip. Strike: he steps forward and throws one powerful straight punch toward the right, arm fully extended.

brawler_02.who: female martial artist in a white gi
brawler_02.action: Wind-up: she takes a stance and pulls her fist back to her hip. Strike: she steps forward and throws one powerful straight punch toward the right, arm fully extended.

sapper_01.who: engineer in a hard hat holding a big wrench
sapper_01.action: Wind-up: he raises the big wrench high over his head with both hands. Strike: he steps forward and smashes the wrench down in front of him toward the right in one heavy blow.

sapper_02.who: female engineer in a hard hat holding a tool
sapper_02.action: Wind-up: she raises the tool high over her head. Strike: she steps forward and smashes it down in front of her toward the right in one heavy blow.

novice_01.who: young adventurer with a short sword and a round shield
novice_01.action: Wind-up: he raises the round shield and pulls the short sword back. Strike: he steps forward and makes one horizontal slash toward the right.

novice_02.who: young female adventurer with a dagger
novice_02.action: Wind-up: she pulls the dagger back at her side. Strike: she steps forward and makes one quick forward stab toward the right.

commander_01.who: young male maestro commander in a navy tailcoat with gold epaulettes holding a silver conductor baton
commander_01.action: Wind-up: he raises the conductor baton high with a sweeping theatrical gesture, coat tails swinging. Strike: he slashes the baton down and forward toward the right in one sharp decisive conducting stroke, pointing at the enemy.

commander_02.who: seductive female maestro commander in a cropped navy tailcoat, black corset and thigh-high stockings holding a silver conductor baton
commander_02.action: Wind-up: she lifts the conductor baton gracefully above her head with a sultry confident pose. Strike: she snaps the baton forward toward the right in one sharp elegant conducting stroke, pointing at the enemy.

motions._comment: attack은 template 사용. 나머지는 여기 text의 {who}/{pron}을 채움. frames는 영상 프레임 수(24fps, 17k+5 단위로 서버가 맞춤). loop=true면 게임에서 반복 재생
